learner_operation: Infer h(x) and g(y), separate dy/g(y)=h(x)dx, integrate with an arbitrary constant, then invert to obtain the requested explicit solution or missing expression and distinguish plausible incorrect integrals/forms.

fixed_features.feature: First-order separable ODEs, elementary primitives, explicit general solutions
fixed_features.justification: Tutorial 6767 requires separating dy/g(y)=h(x)dx; e-10833 integrates and solves explicitly. No initial values or integrating-factor method.

fixed_features.feature: Five-choice radio or explicit-solution scaffold with one blank
fixed_features.justification: All 15 captured questions use these contracts. Scaffolds provide some algebra by design; missing expression still follows the printed ODE.
Tutorial 6767 requires g(y)≠0; roots require local valid branches. Such assumptions need not print their antiderivatives.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Change signed coefficient and constant/linear x multiplier; derive exponent and choices together.
answer_roles.observed: Both easy templates and coefficient signs occur in ordinary fresh seeds and survive delivery; independent boundaries include ±1 and ±12. Batch has five linear cases with three positive and two negative coefficients.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Vary which polynomial term fills the blank while retaining its explicit solution scaffold and arbitrary-constant freedom.
answer_roles.observed: q-128191 changes x² to x⁵; restored q-128198 changes x² to 8x². Both source scaffolds remain supported, including ± branch. Constant shifts accepted without narrowing prompt.

answer_roles.role: Correct choice placement and distinguishing integration/inversion operation
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Position may permute independently; mathematical primitive and distractors must respond to coefficient changes. Fixed root/exponential solution type follows g(y) and is legitimate partial knowledge, but must leave competing choices.
answer_roles.observed: Current radical banks contain multiple candidates with the required power; interval-copy cue removed. Easy sign-only cue leaves ≥2 candidates. Position-only strategies are not perfect in the five-item batch or independent ordinary-seed subgroups.

coverage.result: All 15 prompts match ignoring captured whitespace; complete answer banks, keyed designations and exact worked templates replay. Observed domain/duplicate distractor errors remain evidence-only; served profiles correct them.

5/5 survive. All linear, with a=3,12,-4,-1,1; three magnitude levels beyond signs. Fixed-position and sign-only unique-choice attacks do not solve the batch. This five-item pool is narrow but valid practice of the canonical polynomial route, and is not claimed to cover every source route.

coverage.case: Independent boundaries and fresh natural seeds
coverage.result: 12 boundary controls across both templates; 9 survive inventory. Fresh seeds 942701..942716 give 16 records, 10 survivors, both templates and signs retained. Fixed grid intentionally reused one seed; its common position is an audit control, not natural sampling.

Default and upper boundary for every family, both public blank profiles at 1,2,8 for restored family. All three repaired radical families tested at 1,2,7,8; all twelve coefficient cases survive in the combined moderate delivery.

limitations: Finite review does not prove absence of every shortcut.
